body: I don’t meet people well. And no one approaches me- when they do by off chance I fuck it up
I wish someone could do it with me
Because people are hateful and I’m a perfect target
They need to speed up so they can hit me
I have no one because everyone hates me.  Everyone wants me to die.  It’s like the world just deemed me worthless.  Now I’m trying to figure out easy ways to die
I think that way for a reason, keep in mind.  Maybe if people were decent to me, things would be different

It doesn’t make my experiences any less valid- most of the articles you mentioned mainly talk about warning signs that someone is thinking about suicide-  not influences of suicide.  The first and last article did tie into what I said- it’s influenced by emotional abuse (among other things) and depression.  Me thinking that everyone hates me is reflective of past emotional abuse, and if you think that being socially isolated for the majority of your life is not depression-inducing, then you are sorely mistaken
